stories.title: US stocks rally after weak September jobs report cools Fed rate-hike bets
stories.summary: US employers added 29,000 jobs in September against a consensus of 84,000, and the unemployment rate rose to 4.2% from 4.1%. The S&P 500 rose 0.89%, the Dow 0.64% and the Nasdaq 1.35% on Friday as Treasury yields fell. Odds of an October rate hike dropped to roughly 18%, and Nvidia's market value briefly topped $5.7 trillion. The data bears on the Federal Reserve's next policy decision.

stories.title: Anthropic sticks to 2026 IPO plan despite market jitters and safety concerns
stories.summary: SiliconANGLE reports Anthropic is targeting an offering before Thanksgiving 2026, even as sentiment for new listings weakens; Oura postponed its IPO and another issuer priced below range. A leaked filing reportedly shows an $8 billion operating loss alongside rapid revenue growth. The FTC is reportedly investigating OpenAI and Anthropic over consumer risks, and a voluntary White House AI safety accord has been signed.

stories.title: Security failures questioned after thwarted flydubai hijacking attempt
stories.summary: Times of Israel's live blog reports that an Omani copilot attacked the captain of a Dubai-Tel Aviv flydubai flight in a thwarted hijacking attempt. Security sources say Israeli authorities had no information on him, although a previous employer had reportedly ended his employment over radicalization concerns. Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot linked the lapse to Prime Minister Netanyahu's rejection of a state inquiry into the October 7 attacks. The live blog also reports an Israeli strike in Gaza City targeting Hamas official Ali al-Amoudi that reportedly killed five people.

stories.title: ESA's Juice spacecraft uses Earth flyby to speed toward Jupiter
stories.summary: ESA's Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer passed Earth on September 28, coming within 8,640 km above the Indian Ocean. The gravity assist changed its course by 20 degrees and added 3.5 km/s of speed, needing only one of six planned course corrections. Teams used the pass to test all 10 science instruments. A third and final Earth flyby is planned for January 2029, with arrival at Jupiter in 2031.

stories.title: Previously unknown form of metallic iron found in Chang'e-6 lunar soil
stories.summary: Analysis of lunar soil returned by China's Chang'e-6 mission found a previously unknown form of metallic iron, called gamma-Fe, inside impact-glass particles. According to the report, these particles can preserve stable magnetic properties. The finding adds to understanding of the Moon's magnetic record.

stories.title: Enzyme UBE2N identified as possible natural defense against worsening fatty liver disease
stories.summary: Scientists identified an enzyme, UBE2N, that may act as a natural defense against the worsening of fatty liver disease. The condition is estimated to affect about 100 million Americans. The finding points to a possible target for future treatments, though the report does not describe clinical trials.
